assassin__root.title: Invisibility
assassin__root.description: Unlocks Invisibility (Level 2) (37 mana, 67.33 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__root.extra_description: Cast to briefly grant yourself true invisibility, which hides armor and held items, but immediately wears off upon dealing damage. Mobs also lose aggro. The first skill of the Assassin base.

assassin__wellspring_mastery_ii.title: Wellspring Mastery II
assassin__wellspring_mastery_ii.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__wellspring_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__constitution_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__throw.title: Throw
assassin__throw.description: Unlocks Throw (Level 3) (17 mana, 11.97 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__throw.extra_description: Cast to throw your held item, dealing a base damage plus damage normally inflicted by the item.

assassin__constitution_mastery_iii.title: Constitution Mastery III
assassin__constitution_mastery_iii.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__blood_step.title: Blood Step
assassin__blood_step.description: Unlocks Blood Step (Level 3) (42 mana, 17.96 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__blood_step.extra_description: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, or directly behind any targeted creature. Gain a short duration of true invisibility upon reaching your destination.

assassin__shadow_step.title: Shadow Step
assassin__shadow_step.description: Teaches Shadow Step, an Epic Fight Dodge skill: Sink into the shadows and dash faster than light, immune to physical attacks meanwhile. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

assassin__soul_reprisal.title: Phantom Daggers
assassin__soul_reprisal.description: Unlocks Phantom Daggers (Level 3) (42 mana, 26.93 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__soul_reprisal.extra_description: Launches six cyan spectral daggers in a forward fan. The daggers reverse course after a short distance and can strike enemies again along their return path.

assassin__wellspring_3.title: Wellspring 3
assassin__wellspring_3.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__paradox.title: Paradox
assassin__paradox.description: Unlocks Paradox (Level 1) (128 mana, 134.66 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__paradox.extra_description: Marks one enemy for three temporal strikes, each based on its maximum health. Highest level: 7% per strike, 21% total before legitimate mitigation. Ordinary spell-power bonuses cannot amplify that percentage. No splash damage.

assassin__wellspring_mastery_i.title: Wellspring Mastery I
assassin__wellspring_mastery_i.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__phantom_movement.title: Phantom Movement
assassin__phantom_movement.description: Unlocks Phantom Movement (24 mana, 3 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__phantom_movement.extra_description: Projection Sorcery's dash. Hold to map a path, release to dash along it, always at full output. 3 s cooldown. Naobito's style.

assassin__reservoir_mastery_iii.title: Reservoir Mastery III
assassin__reservoir_mastery_iii.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__anchoring_kunai.title: Anchoring Kunai
assassin__anchoring_kunai.description: Unlocks Anchoring Kunai (Level 2) (26 mana, 134.66 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__anchoring_kunai.extra_description: Give the caster 3 anchoring kunai, dealing damage and apply Anchored Soul effect on hit

assassin__constitution_mastery_i.title: Constitution Mastery I
assassin__constitution_mastery_i.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__ender_obscuris.title: Ender Obscuris
assassin__ender_obscuris.description: Teaches Ender Obscuris, an Epic Fight Dodge skill: Teleport behind the last target you hit within 30 blocks, immune to physical attacks meanwhile. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

assassin__soot_shroud.title: Soot Shroud
assassin__soot_shroud.description: Unlocks Soot Shroud (Level 3) (37 mana, 32.92 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__soot_shroud.extra_description: Cloaks you in soot stealth; breaking the shroud amplifies your next hit.

assassin__reservoir_1.title: Reservoir 1
assassin__reservoir_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__bonebreaker.title: Bonebreaker
assassin__bonebreaker.description: Teaches Bonebreaker, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Repeated hits on the same target deal stacking bonus damage. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

assassin__evasion.title: Evasion
assassin__evasion.description: Unlocks Evasion (Level 2) (51 mana, 179.55 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__evasion.extra_description: Cast to imbue yourself with ender energy. Upon being attacked while under its effects, you will immediately teleport within a short radius and avoid taking any damage.

assassin__wind_blade.title: Wind Blade
assassin__wind_blade.description: Unlocks Wind Blade (Level 3) (16 mana, 3.99 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__wind_blade.extra_description: Slash forward to send out a concentrated blade of wind, slicing through creatures

assassin__surprise_attack.title: Surprise Attack
assassin__surprise_attack.description: Unlocks Surprise Attack (18 mana, 15 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__surprise_attack.extra_description: Cursed Fate's Heavenly Restriction ambush, without its weapon requirement.

assassin__reservoir_mastery_i.title: Reservoir Mastery I
assassin__reservoir_mastery_i.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__splitting_shuriken.title: Splitting Shuriken
assassin__splitting_shuriken.description: Unlocks Splitting Shuriken (Level 3) (18 mana, 4.48 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__splitting_shuriken.extra_description: Throw a spirit shuriken at the target. Upon hit, split into smaller shurikens that deal half of the original damage.

assassin__planned_death_mark.title: Death Mark
assassin__planned_death_mark.description: Unlocks Death Mark (15 mana, 20 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__planned_death_mark.extra_description: Mark an enemy; your melee hits on it deal bonus damage and refund stamina.

assassin__constitution_mastery_ii.title: Constitution Mastery II
assassin__constitution_mastery_ii.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__shadow_slash.title: Shadow Slash
assassin__shadow_slash.description: Unlocks Shadow Slash (Level 3) (51 mana, 22.45 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__shadow_slash.extra_description: Dash forward with a arcing slash of arcane energy, striking creatures in an area. Projectiles hit are deflected. Scales off held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

assassin__critical_knowledge.title: Critical Knowledge
assassin__critical_knowledge.description: Teaches Critical Knowledge, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Attacks, arrows included, have a 20% chance to crit for double damage; Fire Protection on your armor raises the chance and Blast Protection the damage. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

assassin__echoing_strikes.title: Echoing Strikes
assassin__echoing_strikes.description: Unlocks Echoing Strikes (Level 2) (51 mana, 89.78 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__echoing_strikes.extra_description: Non-magical attacks will create an echo, producing a spectral sword to slam down in an area, or a piercing magical arrow to shoot the same target. Echoes do a percent of the original attack's damage.

assassin__renewal_1.title: Renewal 1
assassin__renewal_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__technician.title: Technician
assassin__technician.description: Teaches Technician, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Dodging just before a hit restores stamina. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

assassin__spider_techniques.title: Spider Techniques
assassin__spider_techniques.description: Teaches Spider Techniques, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Hold sprint and jump at a wall to run along it, and leap from wall to wall. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

assassin__constitution_2.title: Constitution 2
assassin__constitution_2.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

assassin__bstep.title: Better Step
assassin__bstep.description: Teaches Better Step, an Epic Fight Dodge skill: A quicker, smoother dodge step. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

assassin__planned_envenom.title: Envenom
assassin__planned_envenom.description: Unlocks Envenom (20 mana, 30 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__planned_envenom.extra_description: Coat your blade: hits poison the target for a while.

assassin__emergency_escape.title: Emergency Escape
assassin__emergency_escape.description: Teaches Emergency Escape, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Dodge even while being hit or out of stamina, and cancel attacks into a dodge. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

assassin__spectral_blink.title: Spectral Blink
assassin__spectral_blink.description: Unlocks Spectral Blink (Level 3) (42 mana, 37.4 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__spectral_blink.extra_description: After activation, the caster has 3 seconds. During this time, they can teleport to any entity they are looking at, even through walls. Any entities within the teleportation range will be revealed to the caster.

assassin__blink.title: Blink
assassin__blink.description: Unlocks Blink (Level 3) (8 mana, 3.99 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
assassin__blink.extra_description: Low-cost, short-ranged teleport in the direction you're moving. Works omni-directionally.
